companyIntro.title: Melbourne-founded, focused on Chinese heat exchanger supplier information
companyIntro.lead: For global industrial buyers, we organize Chinese heat exchanger manufacturers, product capabilities, and sourcing content.
companyIntro.body: HeatEx Direct focuses on industrial heat exchanger sourcing information, organizing company background, product range, application sectors, and quote parameters so buyers can build a clearer basis for judgment before contacting suppliers.
paragraphs: The platform stays tightly focused on industrial heat exchangers and related thermal transfer equipment instead of mixing in unrelated sectors, generic directories, or large volumes of duplicated supplier listings. The objective is not to make the list bigger, but to help buyers recognize more quickly which manufacturers deserve deeper review.

The way information is organized also follows a sourcing and technical review workflow. Manufacturer pages aim to bring company background, product scope, served industries, export markets, media assets, and available documents into a structure that is easier to compare, so buyers spend less time cross-checking disconnected pages.

howItWorks.title: Send a useful request without creating an account
howItWorks.description: A good heat exchanger quote starts with clear operating conditions. The quote request form helps buyers turn project details into a format that a sourcing specialist and relevant manufacturers can actually work with.

steps.title: Research suppliers
steps.body: Start with manufacturer profiles or product pages to understand factory capability, product fit, industries served, and available trust signals.

steps.title: Prepare specifications
steps.body: Enter media, phases, mass flow, temperatures, materials, pressure, flange standards, heat load, and notes in the quote request form.

steps.title: Verify your email
steps.body: No account registration is required. Use a verifiable email address so we can confirm the request is real and contact you about project details.

steps.title: Get specialist follow-up
steps.body: A HeatEx Direct team member reviews the request, checks whether key parameters are missing, and follows up with sourcing support for suitable supplier discussions.
